This gives us a strong foundation in OFC while significantly shortening the time required to build these capabilities organically. We believe RR Kabel’s scale, manufacturing capabilities, market reach and customer relationships can help unlock the next phase of growth for this business, while strengthening our overall cables portfolio.” Furthermore, the acquisition provides RR Kabel with an established platform for its entry into OFC, including ready manufacturing assets, existing approvals and an operating track record. Dear Sir/Madam, Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and in continuation of the Company’s earlier disclosures dated March 25, 2025 and August 7, 2025 regarding the Greenfield expansion facility at Tarapur, we wish to inform you that Phase II of the Greenfield facility has commenced commercial production with effect from September 24, 2026. The Company had earlier intimated that Phase I of the Greenfield facility commenced commercial production with effect from March 11, 2025. The facility has been developed and operationalised in phases with the objective of augmenting the Company’s manufacturing infrastructure and enabling it to meet the requirements of its diverse product portfolio. With the commencement of commercial production of Phase II, the Greenfield facility at Tarapur has been fully commissioned and operationalised. The Company manufactures a wide variety of active pharmaceutical ingredients, each having different manufacturing processes, batch sizes, cycle times, yields, equipment requirements and production characteristics. Accordingly, the aggregate installed capacity cannot be meaningfully expressed as a single uniform quantity, such as tonnes per annum, since the actual production capacity varies depending on the product mix and the type of API manufactured. The capacity addition is therefore intended to be utilised flexibly across the Company’s diverse API product portfolio, based on product requirements, manufacturing schedules and available plant and equipment resources.
